custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create two parts for this test, part A and part B, and set both inactive.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists both.
  • Use a desktop browser that can open a second tab on the same ShopView address, signed in as the same user.
  • Start in browser tab 1 on the Inventory page, on the Inactive tab.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839422-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839422-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
  • To set a part inactive: on the Inventory page's Active tab click Search, type its part number, click its row; in Edit Inventory Part click Inactive under Part Status, click Save, then click Deactivate in the Deactivate part? window. The part then shows on the Inactive tab.
  • Theme: click your avatar (the AS circle) at the top right; Light and Dark are at the bottom of its menu.
  • Second tab: open a new browser tab on the same QA site address (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com); you stay signed in as the same user.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Parts A and B are listed.

Step 2:

  • The menu opens.

Step 3:

  • Bulk mode turns on.

Step 4:

  • The part A row is ticked.

Step 5:

  • The bar reads 2 selected.

Step 6:

  • A second tab opens.

Step 7:

  • Tab 2 shows the Parts left menu.

Step 8:

  • Tab 2 shows the Inventory page.

Step 9:

  • Tab 2's Inactive tab is selected.

Step 10:

  • Part B is listed in tab 2.

Step 11:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens for part B in tab 2.

Step 12:

  • Active is picked under Part Status.

Step 13:

  • The "Activate part?" confirmation opens in tab 2.

Step 14:

  • Tab 2 shows "Part activated.": part B is now active.

Step 15:

  • Tab 1 still shows bulk mode with parts A and B ticked.

Step 16:

  • The "Activate parts?" confirmation reads "2 parts selected."

Step 17:

  • A red message reads "1 part updated, 1 could not be changed." and lists part B with the reason "Part is already in that state."
  • Bulk mode stays on and only part B stays ticked (1 selected), and part A leaves the Inactive list.

Step 18:

  • The red message stayed on screen until you closed it, and now closes.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10816 (Story 3, Activate Parts in Bulk), story SV-10815 (Story 2, Deactivate Parts in Bulk), story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change)

  • S3-R3: “S2-R3 to S2-R10b, S2-R14 to S2-R17 and S2-N3 apply on the Inactive tab exactly as on the Active tab, with "deactivate" read as "activate". The disabled button's hover text is "Tick the parts to activate".”
  • S2-R15: “When some parts fail, the mode stays on and the selection keeps only the parts that failed.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Bulk change, some parts failed | "{n} parts updated, {m} could not be changed." ("1 part updated, {m} could not be changed." for one) | Error toast, stays until closed, lists each failed part and its reason”
  • User Feedback Summary: “A part already in the requested state | "Part is already in that state." | Listed as the failure reason”

Last checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026.
